$:set -euo pipefail
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
SRC='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_horizontal_bisector_10px.png'
DST='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_cross_bisectors_10px.png'
test -f "$SRC"
test ! -e "$DST"
test "$(sha256sum "$SRC" | awk '{print $1}')" = 'a456b0fcde0c8b987e2e7796b6b026e570b1401bb6b6386dc45bd6cce198a748'
python3 -m venv /tmp/fishfry_verticalbisector_venv
/tmp/fishfry_verticalbisector_venv/bin/python -m pip -q install Pillow
/tmp/fishfry_verticalbisector_venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageChops
from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
src=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_horizontal_bisector_10px.png')
dst=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_cross_bisectors_10px.png')
with Image.open(src) as im:
    original=im.convert('RGB')
assert original.size==(1448,1448),original.size
result=original.copy()
# Both dimensions are even; central axis lies between index 723 and 724.
# Exact 10-pixel-width vertical bisector spans x=719 through 728 inclusive.
ImageDraw.Draw(result).rectangle((719,0,728,1447),fill=(0,0,0))
assert result.size==(1448,1448)
assert all(result.getpixel((x,y))==(0,0,0) for x in range(719,729) for y in (0,719,723,724,728,1447))
assert ImageChops.difference(result.crop((0,0,719,1448)),original.crop((0,0,719,1448))).getbbox() is None
assert ImageChops.difference(result.crop((729,0,1448,1448)),original.crop((729,0,1448,1448))).getbbox() is None
result.save(dst,format='PNG',compress_level=6)
print('OUTPUT',dst,'DIMENSIONS',result.size,'VERTICAL_COLUMNS','719..728','HORIZONTAL_ROWS','719..728','SIZE_BYTES',dst.stat().st_size,'SHA256',sha256(dst.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),flush=True)
PY
git add -- "$DST"
test "$(git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l)" -eq 1
git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' commit -m 'Overlay ten-pixel vertical bisector on centered pizza screen'
gh auth setup-git
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8;do
  printf 'PUSH_ATTEMPT %s\n' "$attempt"
  git fetch --quiet origin main
  git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' rebase origin/main
  if git push origin HEAD:main;then
    printf 'COMMITTED ';git rev-parse HEAD
    printf 'REMOTE_HEAD ';gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha
    gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$DST" --jq '[.path,.size,.sha] | @tsv'
    printf 'LOCAL_BLOB ';git hash-object "$DST"
    exit 0
  fi
done
echo 'PUBLICATION_FAILED' >&2
exit 1
